lines.text: The reply of the tongue is from the LORD, and those who commit their works to Him will see their plans achieved.
A man's heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his wages.
A throne is established through righteousness, and a king's favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
Wisdom is better to acquire than gold, and pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a reward.
He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior, and every decision of the lot is from the LORD.
